core_obligations: Set up the framework lemma: assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited locality lemma for universally closed morphisms (proof lines 1469-1475).
Reduce: enough to show $|Y \times_Z X| \to |Y|$ is closed for every affine scheme $Y \to Z$ (proof lines 1475-1481).

Cube diagram: $f'$ universally closed implies $|Y \times_Z Z' \times_Z X| \to |Y \times_Z Z'|$ is closed; $Y \times_Z Z' \to Y$ quasi-compact surjective flat makes $|Y \times_Z Z'| \to |Y|$ submersive (proof lines 1481-1490).

The points-cartesian map $|Y \times_Z Z' \times_Z X| \to |Y \times_Z Z'| \times_{|Y|} |Y \times_Z X|$ is surjective; elementary topology concludes $|Y \times_Z X| \to |Y|$ is closed (proof lines 1490-1499).
proof_roadmap: Feed the locality assumptions into the framework lemma.
Reduce to closedness on fibres over affine test schemes.
Get closedness over the chart and submersivity downstairs.
Assemble with the points-cartesian surjectivity and conclude.
difficulty_reason: The proof runs the framework lemma and then does point-set topology on the cube: universal closedness is reduced to closedness of $|Y \times_Z X| \to |Y|$ for affine test schemes, the chart gives closedness over $Y \times_Z Z'$, submersivity of $|Y \times_Z Z'| \to |Y|$ (fpqc quotient topology) plus surjectivity of the points-cartesian map assemble the closedness downstairs.
